titleOptions: Coheed and Cambria: The Story Behind The Amory Wars
The Amory Wars, Part 1: Where Coheed's Story Came From
The Comic Book Universe Hiding in Coheed and Cambria's Albums
tags: in keeping secrets of silent earth
descriptionIntro: I put on a burned copy of The Second Stage Turbine Blade in my dorm room in 2002. I'm still following the story. Part 1 of a series on Coheed and Cambria's Amory Wars: where it came from, and why it's so hard to know where to start.
pinnedComment: Which Coheed record got you first? And did you ever find those first two Bag On Line comics?
